name: alder-loom-fpa
description: Demo FP&A portals for synthetic companies: ABC Inc. (e-commerce), ABC Agency (marketing agency) and ABC SaaS (B2B subscription software). Password login, dashboards, AI analyst.

scripts.refresh: python3 pipeline/build_datamart.py data/alder_loom_data data/output && cp data/output/datamart.json private/datamart.json
scripts.refresh:agency: python3 -I pipeline/agency/build_datamart.py data/abc_agency_data data/output/agency && cp data/output/agency/datamart.json private/agency/datamart.json
scripts.refresh:saas: python3 -I pipeline/saas/build_datamart.py data/abc_saas_data data/output/saas && cp data/output/saas/datamart.json private/saas/datamart.json
